words.sense: grow or expand rapidly, especially from a new start
misconceptions: Assuming burgeon and flourish mean the same thing whenever both appear relevant.
Ignoring the defining evidence needed for flourish.

words.sense: do very well or thrive, whether growth is fast or slow
misconceptions: Assuming burgeon and flourish mean the same thing whenever both appear relevant.
Ignoring the defining evidence needed for burgeon.

semantic_axes.description: Burgeon focuses on a rapid increase in size or activity; flourish focuses on thriving successfully, even at a steady size.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Laila’s bookshop is doing?

beats.text: Laila’s bookshop has paid its bills and kept loyal customers for six years, with about the same monthly sales.
beats.decisive_clue: steady financial health without rising sales
beats.reason: Steady financial health without rising sales is the strongest evidence for flourish here.

beats.text: She recently painted its front door yellow.
beats.decisive_clue: steady financial health without rising sales; new colour of the front door does not change that
beats.reason: The shop remains healthy despite little expansion; the paint says nothing about growth.

chains.feedback_short: Steady financial health without rising sales still decides; the later detail does not change that.
chains.feedback_deep: Burgeon means grow or expand rapidly, especially from a new start; flourish means do very well or thrive, whether growth is fast or slow. The shop remains healthy despite little expansion; the paint says nothing about growth.
chains.contrast_rule: Burgeon: numbers multiply quickly; flourish: consistent healthy performance.

hints.attention: Focus on its performance over time.
hints.axis: Burgeon focuses on a rapid increase in size or activity; flourish focuses on thriving successfully, even at a steady size.
hints.contrast: Burgeon: numbers multiply quickly; flourish: consistent healthy performance.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the development of Omar’s language club?

beats.text: Omar’s club grew from five members to eighty during its first ten days.
beats.decisive_clue: membership rose sharply in ten days
beats.reason: Membership rose sharply in ten days is the strongest evidence for burgeon here.

beats.text: By the following term membership had settled at eighty, and its weekly meetings continued to draw enthusiastic crowds.
beats.decisive_clue: rapid increase stopped but the club continued doing well
beats.reason: At first the club was expanding rapidly; later it was thriving at a stable size.

chains.feedback_short: Rapid increase stopped but the club continued doing well makes flourish the better choice.
chains.feedback_deep: Burgeon means grow or expand rapidly, especially from a new start; flourish means do very well or thrive, whether growth is fast or slow. At first the club was expanding rapidly; later it was thriving at a stable size.
chains.contrast_rule: Burgeon: numbers multiply quickly; flourish: consistent healthy performance.

hints.attention: Look for a change in pace, not in the club’s identity.
hints.axis: Burgeon focuses on a rapid increase in size or activity; flourish focuses on thriving successfully, even at a steady size.
hints.contrast: Burgeon: numbers multiply quickly; flourish: consistent healthy performance.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the development of Hana’s running group?

beats.text: Hana started with three runners; within two weeks, thirty classmates were meeting to train.
beats.decisive_clue: membership grew tenfold in two weeks
beats.reason: Membership grew tenfold in two weeks is the strongest evidence for burgeon here.

beats.text: Before the month ended, its waiting list had doubled again.
beats.decisive_clue: membership grew tenfold in two weeks; further evidence: new demand also doubled within the month
beats.reason: The continued surge strengthens the evidence of fast expansion.

chains.feedback_short: New demand also doubled within the month confirms the earlier clue: membership grew tenfold in two weeks.
chains.feedback_deep: Burgeon means grow or expand rapidly, especially from a new start; flourish means do very well or thrive, whether growth is fast or slow. The continued surge strengthens the evidence of fast expansion.
chains.contrast_rule: Burgeon: numbers multiply quickly; flourish: consistent healthy performance.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Mei’s garden project is developing?

beats.text: Mei’s garden has supplied vegetables reliably for four seasons with the same six plots.
beats.reason: Productive success across four seasons is the strongest evidence for flourish here.

beats.text: This spring she recruited forty new growers in one week and opened twenty additional plots by Sunday.
beats.decisive_clue: twenty new plots and forty growers in one week
beats.reason: It was already thriving, but the new detail makes sudden expansion the defining development.

chains.feedback_short: Twenty new plots and forty growers in one week makes burgeon the better choice.
chains.feedback_deep: Burgeon means grow or expand rapidly, especially from a new start; flourish means do very well or thrive, whether growth is fast or slow. It was already thriving, but the new detail makes sudden expansion the defining development.
chains.contrast_rule: Burgeon: numbers multiply quickly; flourish: consistent healthy performance.

chains.frame: Which word best describes what has happened to Salma’s reading group?

beats.text: Salma’s group opened on Monday and gained hundreds of members before Friday.
beats.decisive_clue: hundreds joined in a matter of days
beats.reason: Hundreds joined in a matter of days is the strongest evidence for burgeon here.

beats.text: Most newcomers have not posted yet, though invitations are still arriving by the minute.
beats.decisive_clue: rapid sign-ups do not yet establish successful participation
beats.reason: Even without proven engagement, the documented rise in membership is rapid expansion.
